request.action_description: Idle breathing loop: she stands relaxed in a light ready stance, needles held low at her sides, chest rises and falls gently, ponytail sways slightly. Loops seamlessly. TRUE BACK VIEW every frame: seen from directly behind, back of the head and ponytail visible, face never shown; forward movement and attacks go UP the screen; arms and needles stay visible beside the body. She never turns around. Same character in every frame exactly as the reference image: petite adult woman, pale blonde long ponytail with a blue ribbon, red bikini top, red pleated mini skirt, brown belt with a purple pouch, brown gloves, brown thigh-high boots with silver knee guards, a long thin silver sewing needle held in EACH hand like a rapier. Same face, same proportions and same size as the reference; feet stay on the same ground line. Bold outline, clean pixels. No effects, no trails, no glow on the body.
